voice.$description: Voice notes (slice 7a): the recording bar that replaces the input field while recording, and the player in the feed.

dot-size.$description: The red dot of the recording bar (9 px at a 13 px root). A shape that does not pulse.

meter-bar-width.$description: Width of one bar of the level meter (2.6 px at a 13 px root).

meter-gap.$description: Gap between the bars of the level meter.

meter-height.$description: Height of the meter: the tallest bar. About 24 bars stand in a row (the count is in ui/voice/levels.ts).

meter-min-height.$description: The shortest bar: silence still shows a line.

timer-width.$description: Room for the timer of the recording bar up to 59:59 in tabular figures, so the meter does not move as the seconds change.

confirm-gap.$description: Gap between the question and the two buttons of the discard confirmation.

player-width.$description: Width of the player in a bubble (260 px at a 13 px root, between the 240 and 360 px of the spec): fixed, so nothing moves when the duration or the time changes. In a narrow bubble it shrinks to the bubble (max-width 100%).

player-gap.$description: Gap between the play button, the seek bar and the time of the player.

player-button.$description: The round play / pause button of the player (31 px at a 13 px root).

seek-height.$description: The track of the seek bar.

seek-thumb.$description: The thumb of the seek bar (10 px at a 13 px root).

time-width.$description: Room for "0:12 / 0:40" in tabular figures; with hours ("1:02:03 / 1:02:03") the text is allowed to be wider.

speed-width.$description: The speed chip ("1×", "1.5×", "2×"): one width for all three, so the chip does not move.

unplayable-padding.$description: Padding of the "Can't play here" line.
